target: Saken lär inte vara avgjord ännu.
english: The matter is probably not decided yet.
tip: lär here does not mean learn. It signals hearsay or likelihood, so saken lär inte vara avgjord = the matter probably isn't decided.

target: Det vore önskvärt men inte nödvändigt.
english: It would be desirable but not necessary.
tip: vore is the what-if form of vara, meaning would be for unreal situations: det vore önskvärt = it would be desirable.

target: Med god vilja löser vi det här.
english: With good will we'll solve this.
tip: Start a clause with something other than the subject and the verb stays second: Med god vilja löser vi, so löser comes before vi.

target: Hon skäms för misstaget i helgen med vänner.
english: She's ashamed of the mistake she made with friends over the weekend.
tip: skäms always keeps -s but is active, not passive, and takes för for the thing: skäms för misstaget = ashamed of the mistake.
An -s verb can carry a mutual sense: följdes åt means walked with one another, from följas åt (accompany each other).

english: The car was repaired by the mechanic.
tip: In the -s passive, the doer follows av (by): reparerades av mekanikern = was repaired by the mechanic.

target: Han lät som om han menade allvar.
english: He sounded as if he was serious.
tip: som om (as if) sets up something hypothetical and takes the past tense: lät som om han menade = sounded as if he meant.

target: Tvärtom anser jag att det är positivt.
english: On the contrary, I consider it positive.
tip: When a word other than the subject opens the clause, the verb comes next, then the subject: Tvärtom anser jag = on the contrary consider I.
